name: zstr_contains_case_insensitive
description: zStr::ContainsCaseInsensitive uppercases haystack and needle into 128-character local buffers, then returns whether strstr finds the uppercased needle.
known_limits: Binary Ninja decompilation exposes inline strlen/stack-buffer indexing and the neg/sbb boolean return idiom; assembly validates the fastcall inputs, 128-character uppercase buffers, toupper calls, strstr call, and 0/1 return.
tier S verification is deferred until a coherent zStr/cheat-command helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x406a00 receives haystack in ecx and needle in edx, copies up to 128 characters from each through toupper, NUL-terminates both local buffers, calls strstr, and returns 1 when the result is non-null.
The native smoke validates case-insensitive match/miss behavior, empty-string behavior inherited from strstr, and the 128-character truncation boundary.
